sections.description:
MetaForge Engine is a high-performance WordPress custom field builder and modern Advanced Custom Fields engine engineered for developers who demand clean architecture, fast execution, and guaranteed Zero Lock-In.

Whether you are building complex enterprise content models, structured UI components, nested data groups, or dynamic custom post types, MetaForge Engine delivers a visual field builder, a robust developer PHP API, and deep multi-provider AI assistance without database bloat or proprietary format traps.

Why WordPress Developers Choose MetaForge Engine

  • WordPress Custom Field Builder with Clean Database Architecture: Create structured custom meta boxes across posts, pages, custom post types, taxonomy terms, user profiles, and global options pages. All metadata is stored in standard WordPress core tables (wp_postmeta, wp_termmeta, wp_options) without cryptic serialization or proprietary locks.
  • 20 Core Free Field Types Included: Access 20 essential field types right out of the box—including nested Group containers, User Selectors, Post Type Selectors, dynamic Taxonomies, Date/Time pickers, Color pickers, Range sliders, and Buttons with zero artificial limits.
  • Structured Nested Groups & Hierarchies: Build multi-level data models with unlimited nesting depth, memory-safe iteration, and clean PHP template syntax.
  • Seamless 1-Click Migration for Advanced Custom Fields: Seamlessly migrate existing Advanced Custom Fields field groups in a single click via MetaForge → Tools → Switch to MetaForge. The importer automatically converts existing field groups into native MetaForge schemas, allowing developers to query fields using familiar, zero-lock-in metaforge_* template helpers (metaforge_get_field(), metaforge_have_rows(), metaforge_the_row()).
  • WordPress Dynamic Fields & Relational Bindings: Connect custom post types with dynamic AJAX dependencies, taxonomy terms, bidirectional user selectors, and custom query sorting hooks (metaforge_post_order, metaforge_term_order).
  • Visual Custom Post Type & Taxonomy Managers: Create and configure custom post types and hierarchical or tag taxonomies directly in the dashboard without writing code or installing extra plugins.
  • Global Options Pages: Register site-wide settings panels for headers, footers, social links, and API credentials with full field group assignment.
  • Gutenberg Block Bridge: Transform any field group into a native WordPress block (metaforge/ block registry) with zero React or JavaScript boilerplate. Customize block rendering using standard PHP template overrides (template-parts/blocks/{slug}.php).
  • Enterprise Multi-Provider AI Core: Integrate OpenAI (ChatGPT & Responses API), Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Groq (Llama), DeepSeek, or OpenRouter to generate field groups, schemas, and realistic mock data from natural language prompts.
  • Guaranteed Zero Lock-In: Built-in template functions (metaforge_get_field(), metaforge_have_rows(), etc.) are defensively wrapped with function_exists(). If MetaForge Engine is ever deactivated, your templates remain safe from fatal PHP errors, and all custom meta remains 100% accessible via native WordPress get_post_meta() calls.
  • Extend with MetaForge Pro: Unlock 8 advanced field types including Repeaters with drag-and-drop ordering, Flexible Content modular layout builder, Gallery multi-image uploader, Relationship bidirectional selector, oEmbed, Icon Picker, Code Snippet container, and Accordion panels.

Developer PHP Template API & Real-World Examples

MetaForge Engine provides a developer-friendly PHP template API designed for fast theme and plugin development:

1. Standard Custom Meta Field Retrieval (Free)

<?php
// Retrieve a formatted custom field
$hero_title = metaforge_get_field('hero_title');
$hero_image = metaforge_get_field('hero_image'); // Returns formatted image array

if ($hero_title) : ?>
    <div class="hero-banner">
        <h1><?php echo esc_html($hero_title); ?></h1>
        <?php if (!empty($hero_image['url'])) : ?>
            <img src="<?php echo esc_url($hero_image['url']); ?>" alt="<?php echo esc_attr($hero_image['alt']); ?>" />
        <?php endif; ?>
    </div>
<?php endif; ?>

2. Nested Group Field Retrieval (Free)

<?php
// Retrieve nested associative subfields from a Group field
$contact_group = metaforge_get_field('contact_info');

if (!empty($contact_group)) : ?>
    <div class="contact-card">
        <p><strong>Email:</strong> <?php echo esc_html($contact_group['email'] ?? ''); ?></p>
        <p><strong>Phone:</strong> <?php echo esc_html($contact_group['phone'] ?? ''); ?></p>
    </div>
<?php endif; ?>

3. Programmatic Field Group Registration via PHP (Free)

<?php
// Register field groups locally in theme or plugin functions.php
add_action('init', function () {
    if (function_exists('metaforge_add_local_field_group')) {
        metaforge_add_local_field_group([
            'key'      => 'group_property_details',
            'title'    => 'Property Specifications',
            'location' => [
                [
                    ['param' => 'post_type', 'operator' => '==', 'value' => 'property']
                ]
            ],
            'fields'   => [
                [
                    'key'   => 'field_prop_price',
                    'label' => 'Listing Price',
                    'name'  => 'listing_price',
                    'type'  => 'number',
                ],
                [
                    'key'   => 'field_prop_agent',
                    'label' => 'Assigned Agent',
                    'name'  => 'assigned_agent',
                    'type'  => 'user',
                ]
            ]
        ]);
    }
});

4. High-Performance Repeater Field Loop (MetaForge Pro)

<?php
// Loop through a repeater field using standard row syntax (Pro)
if (metaforge_have_rows('pricing_features')) : ?>
    <ul class="features-list">
        <?php while (metaforge_have_rows('pricing_features')) : metaforge_the_row(); ?>
            <li>
                <span class="icon"><?php echo esc_html(metaforge_get_sub_field('icon_class')); ?></span>
                <strong><?php echo esc_html(metaforge_get_sub_field('feature_title')); ?></strong>:
                <?php echo esc_html(metaforge_get_sub_field('feature_description')); ?>
            </li>
        <?php endwhile; ?>
    </ul>
    <?php metaforge_reset_rows(); ?>
<?php endif; ?>

5. Flexible Content Layout Builder Dispatcher (MetaForge Pro)

<?php
// Modular flexible layout builder dispatcher (Pro)
if (metaforge_have_rows('page_sections')) :
    while (metaforge_have_rows('page_sections')) : metaforge_the_row();
        $layout = metaforge_get_row_layout();
        // Dispatches to template-parts/blocks/{layout}.php
        get_template_part('template-parts/blocks/' . sanitize_file_name($layout));
    endwhile;
    metaforge_reset_rows();
endif;
?>

20 Core Free Field Types

MetaForge Engine includes 20 production-ready field types in the free core version:

  1. Text: Single-line text with character counters, prepends/appends, and HTML5 validation.
  2. Textarea: Multi-line text with customizable row height and <br> or <p> auto-formatting.
  3. Number: Integer or floating decimal with min, max, and step boundaries.
  4. Range / Slider: Interactive slider UI for numeric values.
  5. Checkbox: Multi-value checkbox group with dynamic layout direction.
  6. Radio: Single-selection radio button list.
  7. True / False: Binary toggle switch with custom affirmative/negative labels.
  8. Link: Comprehensive URL picker supporting internal post selection, target, and link text.
  9. Button / CTA: Action button configurator with URL, label, styling, and target attributes.
  10. Color Picker: Iris-based color selector with hex and rgba support.
  11. Date & Time Picker: Customizable date, time, and datetime inputs with format presets.
  12. Image: Media modal selector returning structured array, image URL, or attachment ID.
  13. File: Secure media uploader supporting document and asset file types.
  14. WYSIWYG Editor: Full WordPress TinyMCE / visual rich-text editor.
  15. Select: Dropdown menu supporting single or multi-select with search filtering.
  16. Post Type Selector: Dynamic post picker with post type filtering and object return formats.
  17. Taxonomy: Term selector with dynamic AJAX bindings connected to post type selectors.
  18. User Selector: User profile picker filtered by user role and capabilities.
  19. Group: Nested associative subfield containers for structured object grouping.
  20. Tab: Visual section dividers for organizing large meta boxes into clean tabs.

8 Advanced Fields in MetaForge Pro

Upgrade to MetaForge Pro to unlock 8 additional enterprise-grade field types:

  1. Repeater: High-performance repeatable subfield matrix with drag-and-drop sorting.
  2. Flexible Content: Multi-layout modular block builder for dynamic page composition.
  3. Gallery: Multi-image batch uploader with drag-and-drop ordering.
  4. Relationship: Bidirectional post relational selector with live search filtering.
  5. oEmbed: Embed video, audio, and rich media with responsive aspect wrappers.
  6. Icon Picker: Visual vector icon selector.
  7. Code Snippet: Syntax-formatted read-only code display container for documentation and code block presentation.
  8. Accordion: Collapsible interface panels for complex admin forms.

Complete WordPress Administration Suite

  • Custom Post Type Manager: Register and configure custom post types with custom slugs, REST API exposure, dashicons, menu positioning, and hierarchical attributes.
  • Custom Taxonomy Manager: Register hierarchical (category-like) and flat (tag-like) custom taxonomies mapped to any registered post type.
  • Visual Drag-and-Drop Reordering: High-performance batch ordering engine for custom post types and taxonomy terms with query sorting hooks (metaforge_post_order, metaforge_term_order).
  • Global Options Pages: Register custom options pages for site-wide settings (header, footer, social links, API credentials) backed by the metaforge_options post type.
  • Role & Capability Manager: Configure custom WordPress user roles and fine-grained capability assignments (manage_metaforge).
  • JSON Sync & Version Control: Automatically export field group schemas to .json files within your theme or plugin for Git version control and team synchronization.
  • WP-CLI Integration: Execute wp metaforge sync in continuous integration and automated deployment scripts.
  • Tools & System Logs: Built-in authenticated System Logs viewer, export/import tools, and 1-Click “Switch to MetaForge” competitor field group migration.

External Services

MetaForge Engine integrates optional third-party AI service providers to power its AI Layout Assistant, Schema Generator, and Content Generation tools. MetaForge Engine supports the official WordPress 7.0+ Core AI Client (wp_ai_client_prompt()), allowing site administrators to use centralized AI providers configured under Settings > Connectors. For sites running earlier WordPress versions (WP 6.x) or users who wish to supply their own API keys, MetaForge Engine connects directly to user-configured LLM providers. These services are only invoked when a site administrator explicitly configures an API key under MetaForge -> AI Settings and initiates an AI generation action.

* Purpose: Powering natural language field schema generation and content creation.
* Data Sent: Admin-provided prompts and field structure context. No user PII is sent.
* Condition: Sent only when OpenAI is selected as the active AI provider in AI Settings and an AI action is triggered by an administrator.

Post-Activation Setup

  1. Configure AI Settings: Navigate to MetaForge → AI Settings and enter your API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, DeepSeek, or OpenRouter), or define MetaForge_AI_API_KEY in wp-config.php.
  2. Create Custom Post Types & Taxonomies: Use the MetaForge → Post Types and MetaForge → Taxonomies menus to register custom content structures.
  3. Build Field Groups: Go to MetaForge → Field Groups to create new field groups or use the AI Layout Assistant to generate them from natural language.
  4. Setup Git JSON Sync: Enable JSON Sync under settings to commit field group definitions directly into your Git repository.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the metaforge-engine directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory (or upload the .zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin).
  2. Activate MetaForge Engine through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Access MetaForge from the WordPress admin sidebar menu.
sections.faq:
Is MetaForge Engine free to use for WordPress custom fields?

Yes! MetaForge Engine is 100% GPL-licensed open source software. All 20 core field types (including Group, Post Type Selector, Taxonomy, User Selector, Date/Time, Color Picker, Range, and Button), visual custom post type builders, taxonomy managers, global options pages, and developer PHP helper functions are completely free.

What advanced fields are included in MetaForge Pro?

MetaForge Pro unlocks 8 advanced enterprise field types: Repeater fields with drag-and-drop reordering, Flexible Content modular layout builder, Gallery multi-image uploader, Relationship bidirectional selector, oEmbed, Icon Picker, Code Snippet container, and Accordion panels, along with advanced layout workflows.

What makes MetaForge Engine different from other custom field builders?

MetaForge Engine was designed from the ground up as a modern, high-performance Advanced Custom Fields builder. It delivers familiar developer workflows (metaforge_get_field(), metaforge_have_rows(), metaforge_the_row()) combined with modern architectural advantages: single-transient configuration caching to eliminate N+1 database queries, native multi-provider AI schema generation, built-in visual custom post type & taxonomy managers, drag-and-drop post/term ordering, and a 1-click migration tool under MetaForge → Tools.

Where is my custom field and meta box data stored in WordPress?

All custom field data is stored in standard WordPress core database tables (wp_postmeta, wp_termmeta, wp_options). There is zero proprietary data lock-in. Field values can be retrieved at any time using native WordPress functions like get_post_meta($post_id, 'field_name', true).

How do I display custom fields in WordPress theme templates?

MetaForge Engine provides clean, zero-lock-in template helpers:
* metaforge_get_field('field_name'): Returns formatted field data.
* metaforge_the_field('field_name'): Directly echoes sanitized field output.
* metaforge_have_rows('repeater_name') & metaforge_the_row(): Iterates through repeaters and flexible content layouts.
All functions are defensively wrapped with function_exists(), ensuring your templates never crash if the plugin is deactivated.

How does the 1-click migration from Advanced Custom Fields work?

Under MetaForge → Tools → Switch to MetaForge, the plugin automatically scans your database for existing custom field groups and legacy configurations and converts them into native MetaForge format in seconds. Once imported, your existing content remains intact, and you can query your data cleanly using MetaForge’s template helpers.

How do nested fields and Repeater fields perform on high-traffic websites?

Nested Group fields are included free in MetaForge Engine. Repeatable matrix fields (available in MetaForge Pro) bundle repeater rows into optimized, indexed JSON structures, resolving entire repeater trees in a single database read. This eliminates the multi-query performance bottleneck (N+1 queries) found in older custom field plugins.

How does the Flexible Content modular layout builder work?

Available in MetaForge Pro, MetaForge’s Flexible Content field allows content creators to stack customizable layouts (such as Hero Banners, 2-Column Text, Quote blocks, or Feature Grids) in any order. In theme templates, developers use metaforge_have_rows('page_sections') and metaforge_get_row_layout() to dynamically include semantic template parts via get_template_part('template-parts/blocks/' . $layout).

Can I create Gutenberg blocks using MetaForge custom fields?

Yes! The Gutenberg Block Bridge automatically registers any field group as a native WordPress block (metaforge/ block registry) with zero React or JavaScript boilerplate. Developers can render the block output using simple PHP template files (template-parts/blocks/{slug}.php).

Can I register custom field groups programmatically in PHP code?

Yes! MetaForge Engine includes full support for programmatic field group registration via metaforge_add_local_field_group(). You can define field groups in your theme’s functions.php or a custom functionality plugin, keeping your schemas under version control alongside automated Git JSON Sync.

Can I add custom fields to Taxonomies, User Profiles, and Options Pages?

Yes. MetaForge Engine includes comprehensive location rule targeting for Custom Post Types, Pages, Posts, Categories, Tags, Custom Taxonomies, User Profile screens, and custom Global Options Pages registered via the built-in Options Page Manager.

What happens if MetaForge Engine is deactivated? Will my site crash?

No. MetaForge Engine enforces a strict Zero Lock-In architecture. All public helper functions (metaforge_get_field(), metaforge_the_field(), metaforge_have_rows(), etc.) are defensively wrapped with function_exists(). If the plugin is ever deactivated, your theme templates continue executing without fatal PHP errors, and all your raw custom meta remains 100% accessible via standard WordPress get_post_meta() calls.

How does the built-in AI Schema Assistant work?

MetaForge Engine includes multi-provider AI support for OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Groq, DeepSeek, and OpenRouter. You provide your own API key under MetaForge → AI Settings or define MetaForge_AI_API_KEY in wp-config.php. The assistant can generate complete field schemas, post types, and realistic mock data from simple natural language prompts.

Is user data or metadata tracked or transmitted remotely?

No. MetaForge Engine is completely private. It does not track site users, collect telemetry, or transmit any background phone-home data. All AI conversational memory is stored strictly within your local WordPress database (wp_metaforge_ai_memory).

short_description: WordPress custom field builder & Advanced Custom Fields engine. Create custom fields, meta boxes, options pages & dynamic meta with zero lock-in.
description:
MetaForge Engine is a high-performance WordPress custom field builder and modern Advanced Custom Fields engine engineered for developers who demand clean architecture, fast execution, and guaranteed Zero Lock-In.

Whether you are building complex enterprise content models, structured UI components, nested data groups, or dynamic custom post types, MetaForge Engine delivers a visual field builder, a robust developer PHP API, and deep multi-provider AI assistance without database bloat or proprietary format traps.

Why WordPress Developers Choose MetaForge Engine

  • WordPress Custom Field Builder with Clean Database Architecture: Create structured custom meta boxes across posts, pages, custom post types, taxonomy terms, user profiles, and global options pages. All metadata is stored in standard WordPress core tables (wp_postmeta, wp_termmeta, wp_options) without cryptic serialization or proprietary locks.
  • 20 Core Free Field Types Included: Access 20 essential field types right out of the box—including nested Group containers, User Selectors, Post Type Selectors, dynamic Taxonomies, Date/Time pickers, Color pickers, Range sliders, and Buttons with zero artificial limits.
  • Structured Nested Groups & Hierarchies: Build multi-level data models with unlimited nesting depth, memory-safe iteration, and clean PHP template syntax.
  • Seamless 1-Click Migration for Advanced Custom Fields: Seamlessly migrate existing Advanced Custom Fields field groups in a single click via MetaForge → Tools → Switch to MetaForge. The importer automatically converts existing field groups into native MetaForge schemas, allowing developers to query fields using familiar, zero-lock-in metaforge_* template helpers (metaforge_get_field(), metaforge_have_rows(), metaforge_the_row()).
  • WordPress Dynamic Fields & Relational Bindings: Connect custom post types with dynamic AJAX dependencies, taxonomy terms, bidirectional user selectors, and custom query sorting hooks (metaforge_post_order, metaforge_term_order).
  • Visual Custom Post Type & Taxonomy Managers: Create and configure custom post types and hierarchical or tag taxonomies directly in the dashboard without writing code or installing extra plugins.
  • Global Options Pages: Register site-wide settings panels for headers, footers, social links, and API credentials with full field group assignment.
  • Gutenberg Block Bridge: Transform any field group into a native WordPress block (metaforge/ block registry) with zero React or JavaScript boilerplate. Customize block rendering using standard PHP template overrides (template-parts/blocks/{slug}.php).
  • Enterprise Multi-Provider AI Core: Integrate OpenAI (ChatGPT & Responses API), Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Groq (Llama), DeepSeek, or OpenRouter to generate field groups, schemas, and realistic mock data from natural language prompts.
  • Guaranteed Zero Lock-In: Built-in template functions (metaforge_get_field(), metaforge_have_rows(), etc.) are defensively wrapped with function_exists(). If MetaForge Engine is ever deactivated, your templates remain safe from fatal PHP errors, and all custom meta remains 100% accessible via native WordPress get_post_meta() calls.
  • Extend with MetaForge Pro: Unlock 8 advanced field types including Repeaters with drag-and-drop ordering, Flexible Content modular layout builder, Gallery multi-image uploader, Relationship bidirectional selector, oEmbed, Icon Picker, Code Snippet container, and Accordion panels.

Developer PHP Template API & Real-World Examples

MetaForge Engine provides a developer-friendly PHP template API designed for fast theme and plugin development:

1. Standard Custom Meta Field Retrieval (Free)

<?php
// Retrieve a formatted custom field
$hero_title = metaforge_get_field('hero_title');
$hero_image = metaforge_get_field('hero_image'); // Returns formatted image array

if ($hero_title) : ?>
    <div class="hero-banner">
        <h1><?php echo esc_html($hero_title); ?></h1>
        <?php if (!empty($hero_image['url'])) : ?>
            <img src="<?php echo esc_url($hero_image['url']); ?>" alt="<?php echo esc_attr($hero_image['alt']); ?>" />
        <?php endif; ?>
    </div>
<?php endif; ?>

2. Nested Group Field Retrieval (Free)

<?php
// Retrieve nested associative subfields from a Group field
$contact_group = metaforge_get_field('contact_info');

if (!empty($contact_group)) : ?>
    <div class="contact-card">
        <p><strong>Email:</strong> <?php echo esc_html($contact_group['email'] ?? ''); ?></p>
        <p><strong>Phone:</strong> <?php echo esc_html($contact_group['phone'] ?? ''); ?></p>
    </div>
<?php endif; ?>

3. Programmatic Field Group Registration via PHP (Free)

<?php
// Register field groups locally in theme or plugin functions.php
add_action('init', function () {
    if (function_exists('metaforge_add_local_field_group')) {
        metaforge_add_local_field_group([
            'key'      => 'group_property_details',
            'title'    => 'Property Specifications',
            'location' => [
                [
                    ['param' => 'post_type', 'operator' => '==', 'value' => 'property']
                ]
            ],
            'fields'   => [
                [
                    'key'   => 'field_prop_price',
                    'label' => 'Listing Price',
                    'name'  => 'listing_price',
                    'type'  => 'number',
                ],
                [
                    'key'   => 'field_prop_agent',
                    'label' => 'Assigned Agent',
                    'name'  => 'assigned_agent',
                    'type'  => 'user',
                ]
            ]
        ]);
    }
});

4. High-Performance Repeater Field Loop (MetaForge Pro)

<?php
// Loop through a repeater field using standard row syntax (Pro)
if (metaforge_have_rows('pricing_features')) : ?>
    <ul class="features-list">
        <?php while (metaforge_have_rows('pricing_features')) : metaforge_the_row(); ?>
            <li>
                <span class="icon"><?php echo esc_html(metaforge_get_sub_field('icon_class')); ?></span>
                <strong><?php echo esc_html(metaforge_get_sub_field('feature_title')); ?></strong>:
                <?php echo esc_html(metaforge_get_sub_field('feature_description')); ?>
            </li>
        <?php endwhile; ?>
    </ul>
    <?php metaforge_reset_rows(); ?>
<?php endif; ?>

5. Flexible Content Layout Builder Dispatcher (MetaForge Pro)

<?php
// Modular flexible layout builder dispatcher (Pro)
if (metaforge_have_rows('page_sections')) :
    while (metaforge_have_rows('page_sections')) : metaforge_the_row();
        $layout = metaforge_get_row_layout();
        // Dispatches to template-parts/blocks/{layout}.php
        get_template_part('template-parts/blocks/' . sanitize_file_name($layout));
    endwhile;
    metaforge_reset_rows();
endif;
?>

20 Core Free Field Types

MetaForge Engine includes 20 production-ready field types in the free core version:

  1. Text: Single-line text with character counters, prepends/appends, and HTML5 validation.
  2. Textarea: Multi-line text with customizable row height and <br> or <p> auto-formatting.
  3. Number: Integer or floating decimal with min, max, and step boundaries.
  4. Range / Slider: Interactive slider UI for numeric values.
  5. Checkbox: Multi-value checkbox group with dynamic layout direction.
  6. Radio: Single-selection radio button list.
  7. True / False: Binary toggle switch with custom affirmative/negative labels.
  8. Link: Comprehensive URL picker supporting internal post selection, target, and link text.
  9. Button / CTA: Action button configurator with URL, label, styling, and target attributes.
  10. Color Picker: Iris-based color selector with hex and rgba support.
  11. Date & Time Picker: Customizable date, time, and datetime inputs with format presets.
  12. Image: Media modal selector returning structured array, image URL, or attachment ID.
  13. File: Secure media uploader supporting document and asset file types.
  14. WYSIWYG Editor: Full WordPress TinyMCE / visual rich-text editor.
  15. Select: Dropdown menu supporting single or multi-select with search filtering.
  16. Post Type Selector: Dynamic post picker with post type filtering and object return formats.
  17. Taxonomy: Term selector with dynamic AJAX bindings connected to post type selectors.
  18. User Selector: User profile picker filtered by user role and capabilities.
  19. Group: Nested associative subfield containers for structured object grouping.
  20. Tab: Visual section dividers for organizing large meta boxes into clean tabs.

8 Advanced Fields in MetaForge Pro

Upgrade to MetaForge Pro to unlock 8 additional enterprise-grade field types:

  1. Repeater: High-performance repeatable subfield matrix with drag-and-drop sorting.
  2. Flexible Content: Multi-layout modular block builder for dynamic page composition.
  3. Gallery: Multi-image batch uploader with drag-and-drop ordering.
  4. Relationship: Bidirectional post relational selector with live search filtering.
  5. oEmbed: Embed video, audio, and rich media with responsive aspect wrappers.
  6. Icon Picker: Visual vector icon selector.
  7. Code Snippet: Syntax-formatted read-only code display container for documentation and code block presentation.
  8. Accordion: Collapsible interface panels for complex admin forms.

Complete WordPress Administration Suite

  • Custom Post Type Manager: Register and configure custom post types with custom slugs, REST API exposure, dashicons, menu positioning, and hierarchical attributes.
  • Custom Taxonomy Manager: Register hierarchical (category-like) and flat (tag-like) custom taxonomies mapped to any registered post type.
  • Visual Drag-and-Drop Reordering: High-performance batch ordering engine for custom post types and taxonomy terms with query sorting hooks (metaforge_post_order, metaforge_term_order).
  • Global Options Pages: Register custom options pages for site-wide settings (header, footer, social links, API credentials) backed by the metaforge_options post type.
  • Role & Capability Manager: Configure custom WordPress user roles and fine-grained capability assignments (manage_metaforge).
  • JSON Sync & Version Control: Automatically export field group schemas to .json files within your theme or plugin for Git version control and team synchronization.
  • WP-CLI Integration: Execute wp metaforge sync in continuous integration and automated deployment scripts.
  • Tools & System Logs: Built-in authenticated System Logs viewer, export/import tools, and 1-Click “Switch to MetaForge” competitor field group migration.

External Services

MetaForge Engine integrates optional third-party AI service providers to power its AI Layout Assistant, Schema Generator, and Content Generation tools. MetaForge Engine supports the official WordPress 7.0+ Core AI Client (wp_ai_client_prompt()), allowing site administrators to use centralized AI providers configured under Settings > Connectors. For sites running earlier WordPress versions (WP 6.x) or users who wish to supply their own API keys, MetaForge Engine connects directly to user-configured LLM providers. These services are only invoked when a site administrator explicitly configures an API key under MetaForge -> AI Settings and initiates an AI generation action.

  1. OpenAI API

* Service: OpenAI LLM APIs (ChatGPT & Responses API)
* Purpose: Powering natural language field schema generation and content creation.
* Data Sent: Admin-provided prompts and field structure context. No user PII is sent.
* Condition: Sent only when OpenAI is selected as the active AI provider in AI Settings and an AI action is triggered by an administrator.
* Terms of Service: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/
* Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

Post-Activation Setup

  1. Configure AI Settings: Navigate to MetaForge → AI Settings and enter your API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, DeepSeek, or OpenRouter), or define MetaForge_AI_API_KEY in wp-config.php.
  2. Create Custom Post Types & Taxonomies: Use the MetaForge → Post Types and MetaForge → Taxonomies menus to register custom content structures.
  3. Build Field Groups: Go to MetaForge → Field Groups to create new field groups or use the AI Layout Assistant to generate them from natural language.
  4. Setup Git JSON Sync: Enable JSON Sync under settings to commit field group definitions directly into your Git repository.
